question: Which country won the FIFA World Cup 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Argentina**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Argentina** won the **FIFA World Cup 2022**.
 
• The final match was held on December 18, 2022, at Lusail Iconic Stadium in Lusail, Qatar.
 
• Argentina defeated France in a thrilling match that ended in a penalty shootout.
 
• This victory marked Argentina's third FIFA World Cup win, with previous victories in 1978 and 1986.
 
• **Lionel Messi**, the captain of the Argentine team, played a pivotal role in the tournament and was awarded the **Golden Ball** as the **best player of the tournament**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The FIFA World Cup 2022 was the** 22nd edition of the FIFA World Cup**, the quadrennial international men's football championship.
 
• **Qatar **was the **first Middle Eastern country to host the FIFA World Cup**.
 
• The tournament featured 32 teams and was held from **November 20 to December 18, 2022**.
 
• France, the defending champions from the 2018 World Cup, played exceptionally well throughout the tournament but fell short in the final.
 
• The event was widely celebrated and watched by millions of football fans around the world.
